meaning:
κραταιόω, -ῶ
(late form of κρατύνω; κράτος) [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק ;]
to strengthen; pass., to wax strong: Luk.2:40, 1Co.16:13; πνεύματι, Luk.1:80; δυνάμει κ. διὰ τ. πνεύματος, Eph.3:16.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: The child was growing and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.
Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,
